name: Nami no Mani Mani Gaiden Yumiko-san no Shinkon Nikki
original_name: 波の間に間に 外伝 裕美子さんの新婚日記
source:
After a few years, Shintaro Shinohara - the protagonist of the first game - now the doctor of the island, marries the beautiful widow Yumiko.

This is their newly-married happy love-love life.

[Shortly translated from the [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=442285]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
数年后，前作主人公篠原新太郎已成为岛上的医生，并与美丽的寡妇向井裕美子结婚。

这是他们新婚后幸福恩爱的生活。

[根据[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=442285]Getchu.com[/url]上的简介简译]
